question: 基础上升趋势的完整周/月决策母样本中，双均线距离是否对未来收益/风险有稳定且相对已有技术信息的增量？
strategy_layer: A回调位置技术信息研究，非策略优化
authority: 用户本次A01授权+技术研究范围校正，桌面原文只读
scope: 均线N20/60/120共同注册，N60/W主呈现但所有结果保留

features.price_basis: economic OHLC proxy = nominal OHLC * economic_index/nominal_close by exact same date; actions already represented; not twice adding dividends; not a fillable price
features.EMA: existing seeded_ema alpha=2/(N+1), first N SMA seed on declared 252-row warmup+formal indexed official calendar, no reset/interpolate after internal missing, unknown preserved
features.SMA: last N actual calendar rows min_periods=N
features.ATR: main EMA20 of TR, seed SMA20 of first valid TR; legacy simple20 diagnostic frozen separately if affordable; zero/missing excludes
features.band: lo=min(SMA_N,EMA_N),hi=max(...); C distance=(C-hi)/ATR if above; (C-lo)/ATR if below;0 inside
features.mother: every fixed W/M decision with valid features and SMA60(t)>SMA60(t-5); no distance/first/RR/A-event prefilter; equality not up
features.events: date+asset+N shared state cluster; new cluster on environment false→true or distance-state change; no claim statistical independence
features.weights: each eligible ETF same total weight, within ETF each date equal; uncertainty resamples common whole time blocks across all ETF

labels.start: decision after close; entry next calendar session nominal open transformed using economic daily scale; end=entry date inclusive hth session close; require every path quote and known consistent scale
metrics: MFE_over_absMAE undefined if MAE0 reported missing
labels.cost_sensitivity: 0.10% and0.30% total roundtrip illustrative, not venue tariff or validated executable net account
labels.price_limit: next-open indicative market price; actual fill unavailable, no optimized stop or target

models.F_only: asset identity + signed distance + signed distance squared + inside dummy
models.B1: asset dummies + past20return+past60return+20dayvol+SMA60 five-day slope/ATR+drawdown60+510300 past20price return+510300 SMA60 slope flag
models.B2: B1 + six SMA/EMA one-day direction flags + SMA20>SMA60>SMA120 and EMA stack + c>EMA20 + c>lag20 + downside_key_wave(c<EMA20 &c<lag20) + c>previous20high and c<previous20low (all known)
models.method: weighted ridge; train zscore only; fixed lambda=1 in sum-weight-normalized objective; no hyperparameter search; intercept unpenalized; probabilities weighted ridge clipped0,1, labeled simple probability approximation no calibration claim
models.common_rows: each B0/F/B1/B1F/B2/B2F same eligible evaluation dates, no excluding bad model rows
models.OOS: purged forward retrospective time evaluation, all history previously seen; no sealed clean holdout, no evidenceC
models.fit_minimum: 20 train rows/at least2 evaluation assets,otherwise unestimated reason

uncertainty.method: 2000 synchronized circular moving date-block draws resample full cross-section; maintain ETF equalweight; missing absent groups no zero fill and valid draw count
uncertainty.block: primary60calendar sessions (approx13 W/3M observations); diagnostic120sessions; for h120 labels block120 minimum
uncertainty.multitest: six N*freq primary family, exploratory all; no significance promotion, no best N selection
uncertainty.meaning: no preagreed materiality criterion, not economic-pass claim

robustness: all ETF/year results and leave-one-ETF headline recalculation
freeze percentage distance quadratic alternative for B2 20d only, count6 configs
freeze main ATR to simple20 sensitivity B2 20d only if needed count6
remove top1%abs return based train cutoff only diagnostic
technical near episodes daily→nextW/M price waiting/status persistence table, not simulated intra-day touch
deployment: audit strict existingA-minus-distance reconstruction before any market claim; A2 anchors other conditions; if no identifiable distance-independent candidate universe mark blocked and never call mother deploymentA
completion: finish audited broad historical A01 info question with full tables; strict deployment gap and true new data verification separate blocked scopes, do not claim fullstrategy verified
